_note: Map shots for History Map (naah repo, vendor/historymap on branch america-historymap-tools). Coordinates are [lon, lat]. 'dur' is a placeholder at 2.6 words/s; retime from the voiceover .srt when it exists. Every map shot changes something every 2-3 s (camera move, region fade, arrow draw, pin pop). Style: satellite, labels off; our own labels in Patrick Hand. Positions marked 'illustrative' must not be presented as exact locations.

shots.line: on the 28th of February, the United States and Israel launched strikes on Iran
It shut the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow strip of water between Iran and Oman that carries close to a fifth of the world's oil
In July, the US Navy put its blockade of Iranian ports back in place, and Iran kept hitting ships
Tankers started slipping through the southern side of the strait ... pipelines that skip Hormuz completely
shots._check: Pipeline endpoints are the real terminals (Abqaiq→Yanbu, Habshan→Fujairah); draw them as straight arrows, not as exact pipeline routes.

shots.line: A third American aircraft carrier just arrived in the region
shots._check: Carrier positions are illustrative (not reported). Keep the label generic; no ship names on pins.

shots.line: Ship traffic through Hormuz is still about sixty-five percent below normal. Tankers are still being hit.

pins.name: TANKER HIT · 20 NOV
pins._check: approximate: reported 'in the Strait of Hormuz'

shots.line: So what happens to oil in January? It comes down to three roads.
shots._note: End on the globe so the cut to the cartoon 'three roads' fork feels like pulling back to the big picture.
